description: Office of the Cabinet Ministers - Appointments of Secretaries to State  Ministries
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the appointments of named individuals (e.g., Mr. R. M. A. Rathnayaka) to specific government positions (Secretaries to State Ministries). It provides only the basic titles of the ministries they are assigned to (e.g., "State Ministry of Money & Capital Market...") but does not include any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities, functions, or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
